verificationScope: Conflict choices reviewed by subsystem ownership; aggregate build/type/lint/doc checks and focused tests are recorded in the integration report. Static review is not per-path runtime proof.

resolutionRules.preserve-frozen-community-archive: Keep the accepted community archived record unchanged; archived-note verification passed.
resolutionRules.merge-both-behaviors: Adapt the upstream owner interface and retain still-applicable community behavior; compile and focused subsystem checks apply. Documentation follows final owners and bilingual gates.
resolutionRules.retain-community-shell-and-release-workf: Keep the community Desktop entry, installer and release ownership. Do not restore replaced official publishing paths; extract necessary resource/runtime changes explicitly.
resolutionRules.retain-community-ui-with-upstream-api: Use upstream Client contracts while retaining community mobile navigation, archive, model search, approval language/details, prompts and team guidance; component tests and native boot apply.
resolutionRules.regenerate-from-integrated-source: Regenerate the artifact from final merged source and manifests; do not choose an entire generated file from either parent. Verify owning freshness/type gates.
resolutionRules.integrate-upstream-connection-with-nas-r: Adopt Peer/RBAC and explicit NAS identity/resource policies. Retain trusted-host authentication and local-only carrier boundaries; verify live revoke/expiry, RPC/HTTP/WS/file denial and role fixtures.
